title: Bouguer gravity maps of Ware Shoals East and Ware Shoals West 7.5 minute quadrangles
citation: Lawrence, D.P., 1986, Bouguer gravity maps of Ware Shoals East and Ware Shoals West 7.5 minute quadrangles: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-56, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: SCGS OFR-56 (Lawrence, 1986), simple Bouguer gravity maps of the Ware Shoals West and Ware Shoals East 7.5-minute quadrangles (two sheets): one-milligal gravity contours and gravity stations on topographic bases (Bouguer density 2.67). No geologic units, structures, drill holes or geologic surfaces; gravity values are geophysical and do not fit the schema, so nothing is recorded (same treatment as other Bouguer maps). SUBSURFACE: none.
